audit_items.proof_trace: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY lacks the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, so Next.js never inlines it into any client bundle — this is a framework-level guarantee. The server.ts module also imports cookies() from next/headers (a Node.js-only API), preventing client component imports. All callers are server-side: actions.ts and actions-new.ts carry 'use server', service files have no 'use client', and the one direct caller in dashboard/layout.tsx is an async Server Component.
